Name: Nightmare's Farmhouses for Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
I actually had this sitting in my folders since last summer, all converted and ready to upload but for some reason I... Didn't? Maybe I was hoping they'd get updated by the original mod's creator? IDK

Anyway, Last summer I began trying to piece together depreciated decorative mods. Which have been long since abandoned by creators who have moved on, and I hope to attempt to give them new life.

This is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/318?tab=description]Nightmare's Farmhouses[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].

It includes each color presented in the original mod, plus the three additional colors by taintedwheat.

[i][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] If the original mod author wishes me to take this down, or wishes to update the original mod with the alternative texture pack I've created. They are welcome to DM me and I can accomodate. The sprites were created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/23988239]zcsnightmare[/url], all I did was format them and set them up for Alternative Textures Use. This effort only exists to make older mods more accessible to modern versions of Stardew Valley.
[/i]
